两个三角形形状相同、大小不同，对应边的比相等，这个比 $k$ 叫相似比。: Two triangles with the same shape but different sizes: the ratios of corresponding sides are equal, and this ratio $k$ is called the similarity ratio.

两个数相乘，交换位置，积不变。: When two numbers are multiplied, swapping their order does not change the product.

连续除以两个数，等于除以这两个数的积。: Dividing by two numbers one after the other equals dividing by their product.
分母相同的分数相加减，分母不变，只把分子相加减。: When adding or subtracting fractions with the same denominator, the denominator stays the same and only the numerators are added or subtracted.
先通分再加：分母 $b$、$d$ 的乘积作公分母，分子交叉相乘后相加。: Find a common denominator first, then add: use the product of the denominators $b$ and $d$ as the common denominator, and add the numerators after cross-multiplying.
分数的分子、分母同时乘或除以同一个不为 0 的数，分数大小不变。: Multiplying or dividing both the numerator and the denominator of a fraction by the same non-zero number does not change the value of the fraction.
分数乘分数，分子乘分子，分母乘分母，能约分要先约分。: To multiply fractions, multiply numerator by numerator and denominator by denominator; simplify first when possible.
除以一个分数，等于乘它的倒数（分子分母颠倒）。: Dividing by a fraction equals multiplying by its reciprocal (numerator and denominator swapped).
部分除以总量，再乘 100%，表示部分占总量的百分之几。: Divide the part by the whole, then multiply by 100%; this gives the part as a percentage of the whole.

折扣是原价的几成，八折就是乘 0.8，现价是实际要付的钱。: A discount is a fraction of the original price (a 20% discount means multiplying by 0.8); the sale price is the money actually paid.

利息由本金、利率和存期决定；利率一般按年计算，时间单位是年。: Interest depends on the principal, the rate and the time deposited; the rate is usually per year, so the time is in years.
本金 1000 元，年利率 3%，存 2 年：$1000\\times0.03\: Principal 1000 yuan, annual rate 3%, deposited for 2 years: $1000\times0.03\times2=60$ yuan
比例中两个外项的积等于两个内项的积，可以用来求未知项。: In a proportion, the product of the two outer terms equals the product of the two inner terms; this can be used to find an unknown term.
两个量的比值（商）一定，它们成正比例；$k$ 是这个不变的比值。: If the ratio (quotient) of two quantities is constant, they are directly proportional; $k$ is this constant ratio.
两个量的积一定，它们成反比例；一个变大，另一个变小。: If the product of two quantities is constant, they are inversely proportional; when one increases, the other decreases.

$s$ 是路程，$v$ 是速度，$t$ 是时间；知道其中两个就能求第三个。: $s$ is the distance, $v$ is the speed and $t$ is the time; knowing any two gives the third.
把所有数据加起来，再除以数据的个数 $n$，得到平均数。: Add up all the data, then divide by the number of data values $n$ to get the mean.

单价 5 元，买 4 个：总价 $=5\\times4=20$ 元: Unit price 5 yuan, buying 4: total price $=5\times4=20$ yuan
工作效率是单位时间做的工作量；总量等于效率乘时间。: The work rate is the amount of work done per unit of time; the total work equals the rate times the time.

幂再乘方，底数不变，指数相乘。: To raise a power to a power, keep the base and multiply the exponents.
积的乘方，等于每个因数分别乘方，再把结果相乘。: The power of a product equals the product of the powers of each factor.

不等式两边同乘正数，方向不变；同乘负数，不等号要反向。: Multiplying both sides of an inequality by a positive number keeps its direction; multiplying by a negative number reverses the inequality sign.
利润率表示赚的钱占成本的百分之几。利润 = 售价 - 成本。: The profit margin shows what percentage of the cost the profit is. Profit = selling price − cost.
底数相同的幂相除，底数不变，指数相减（底数不能为 0）。: To divide powers with the same base, keep the base and subtract the exponents (the base cannot be 0).
任何不等于 0 的数的 0 次幂都等于 1。: Any non-zero number raised to the power 0 equals 1.
负指数表示倒数：$a^{-n}$ 是 $a^n$ 的倒数。: A negative exponent means the reciprocal: $a^{-n}$ is the reciprocal of $a^n$.
两数的和乘两数的差，等于它们的平方差。可用来简便计算。: The sum of two numbers times their difference equals the difference of their squares. It can be used for quick calculation.
两数和（或差）的平方，等于平方和加上（或减去）它们乘积的 2 倍。: The square of the sum (or difference) of two numbers equals the sum of their squares plus (or minus) twice their product.

每一项都有公因式 $m$，就把 $m$ 提到括号外面。: If every term has the common factor $m$, take $m$ out in front of the brackets.
两个平方数相减，可以分解成两数之和乘两数之差。: The difference of two squares can be factored into the sum of the two numbers times their difference.

分式的分子分母同乘（或同除以）同一个不为 0 的数，分式的值不变。: Multiplying (or dividing) the numerator and denominator of a rational expression by the same non-zero number does not change its value.

$\\sqrt a$ 的平方等于 $a$（$a\\ge0$）；$a$ 的平方再开: The square of $\sqrt a$ equals $a$ ($a\ge0$); taking the square root of the square of $a$ gives the absolute value of $a$.
积的算术平方根，等于各因数算术平方根的积。常用来化简根式。: The arithmetic square root of a product equals the product of the arithmetic square roots of the factors. Often used to simplify radicals.

物体受到的浮力，等于它排开的液体受的重力，$V_{排}$ 是排开液体的体积。: The buoyant force on an object equals the weight of the liquid it displaces, where $V_{\text{displaced}}$ is the volume of the displaced liquid.

物体漂浮或悬浮在液体中时，处于平衡状态，浮力等于重力。: When an object floats or is suspended in a liquid, it is in equilibrium and the buoyant force equals its weight.
